bio.text: Jeffrey Haggit is the Constitution Party candidate for Wyoming's U.S. House seat in 2026.
In his WyoFile election guide response, Haggit says he was born in Midland, Michigan, lives in Mountain View, and graduated from Western Wyoming College in 1978.
He says he recently retired after almost 49 years as an electrician and instrumentation technician at the TATA trona processing facility in southwest Wyoming.
He says he is vice-chairman of the Constitution Party of Wyoming and has served as its state chair.
